title: SoftwareOne
description: softwareone.com SoftwareOne Turkiye is the Turkish arm of SoftwareOne Holding AG, a Swiss-listed global software and cloud solutions provider that merged with Crayon to form a 13,000 person company operating in over 70 countries. Based in Ataşehir, Istanbul and active since 2019, it employs around 40 to 60 people and works with 100 percent of Turkey's top 50 companies and 80 percent of the top 500. Services span software licensing advisory for Microsoft, IBM and Oracle, cloud migration across Azure, AWS and Google Cloud, DevSecOps, cybersecurity, AI and FinOps. In December 2024 SoftwareOne AG acquired full ownership of the Turkish entity, approved by the Turkish Competition Authority. Led by Managing Director Doğa Pekdemir and CFO Hakan Keriş, it has delivered projects for Turkish Airlines, TAV Airports, Coca-Cola and Vakıf Katılım. Key strengths are its unmatched enterprise market coverage in Turkey and full access to the global SoftwareOne and Crayon ecosystem.
